model: Fidelity quantum-kernel SVM (ZZ feature map, linear entanglement, exact statevector simulation)
selection_rule: Chosen on VALIDATION only, rule fixed before any test prediction: among 144 trials (3 layer counts x 8 bandwidths x 6 values of C), take the shallowest circuit whose best validation macro-F1 is within 0.01 of the overall best.
control_selection_rule: Same 144-trial budget (24 gammas x 6 C); highest validation macro-F1.
default_input: 13 raw features -> StandardScaler -> PCA(8) -> StandardScaler (fitted on training rows only)
